say: Your one hundred dollars didn't disappear.
Nobody took money from your account.
But now it buys less than it used to.
When prices rise over time, each dollar has less purchasing power.
So having more money doesn't always mean you're getting richer.
What really matters is what that money can actually buy.
That's why people say inflation quietly eats away at the value of your money.
Your balance can stay exactly the same...
while your buying power gets smaller.
